**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

- **Operative clause:** § 13 Term of Agreement (p0078) — 1-year initial term, automatic renewal for **successive one-year periods**, exitable by either party (including Client) on **30 days'** written notice of intent not to renew.
- **Fallback test:** notice window 30 days ≤ 60-day ceiling ✔; renewal term 12 months, so no automatic multi-year renewal and no walk-away trigger ✔.
- **Price uplift:** no renewal price-increase mechanic anywhere. § 5 (p0045) fixes fees by the Exhibit A/B schedule, and § 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year plus an MFN rate covenant — the conditional 5%/CPI cap element is not engaged.
- **Noted, not redlined:** the preferred Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal is absent; per the playbook this is a minor preferred-only sub-element and does not justify reopening a clause that already gives us a 30-day exit.

No redline proposed.
